summary.text: Dark Capital Strength Tiger is a totem Blue Phoenix Tribe elders name on Hei Lou Lan, and that Lu Tong Lan confirms. The narration then calls it Hei Lou Lan's strongest killer move.

claims.text: Hei Lou Lan sits on a stone bed and looks at a totem on her chest. The markings are simple and clear: a young black cat, tail raised, crouched as if to pounce. She has used Gu worms lent by Desolate Extremity, and the first form of her totem killer move is complete after thirty days in Myriad Beast Fusion Color Heaven. Blue Phoenix Tribe elders confront Lu Tong Lan over immortal materials spent on her illegitimate daughter. Lu Tong Lan calls Hei Lou Lan out. The elders stare at the totem on her chest. Lu Tong Lan says that only the sacred physique can cultivate this totem. Hei Lou Lan thinks they mean her Great Strength True Martial Physique. With the tribe’s help the totem grows from a small cat into a black leopard. Immortal material expenditure is immense. When used, the totem has incredible power, far beyond her previous methods.

With Lu Tong Lan’s support Hei Lou Lan devours a large amount of immortal materials. After digesting them, her totem reaches greater success. Lu Tong Lan says the dark capital strength tiger totem has formed completely, and that with this move Hei Lou Lan is a peak expert among rank sevens, even in the outside world of the five regions. The path ahead is to continue eating with the dark capital strength tiger as the foundation, and to fuse other dao marks so the totem gradually suits Hei Lou Lan specifically. On Myriad Life Road a Predicament swallows Hei Lou Lan and Lu Tong Lan. After strength path killer moves stir the space, Hei Lou Lan calls the dark capital strength tiger out and expends a large amount of rank seven immortal essence. A huge black tiger condenses from surging black light and charges. A huge hole forms. Hei Lou Lan and Lu Tong Lan fly out through it.

The dark capital strength tiger totem created a huge hole and caused the Predicament to weaken greatly. The Predicament shrinks, mends the hole, and runs. Hei Lou Lan does not chase it. After encountering another Predicament, Lu Tong Lan uses her blue phoenix totem and works with the dark capital strength tiger to defeat the Predicament.

Hei Lou Lan, Yellow Bell Tribe Leader, and a rank seven Gu Immortal fight a Predicament. Hei Lou Lan’s dark capital strength tiger totem is crippled. Yellow Bell Tribe Leader’s golden bell totem is greatly damaged. The rank seven Gu Immortal’s rain eagle totem and thunder fish totem lose their ability to fight.

Fang Yuan records that Zhan Bu Du heard of over nine thousand basic totems in Myriad Beast Fusion Color Heaven. Dark capital strength tiger is listed among them, with rain eagle totem, thunder fish totem, and golden bell totem. Aside from basic totems there are also unique totems that belong to certain individuals.

The totem killer moves Zhan Bu Du brought from Myriad Beast Fusion Color Heaven are divided into basic totems, unique totems, and super totems. There are thousands of basic totems, including dark capital strength tiger, golden bell totem, and rain eagle totem.

In Northern Plains, a black tiger with metallic luster, huge like a mountain, tears ginseng roots with its claws. Wu Guang sees that this is a killer move, not an ancient desolate beast. The black tiger and the ginseng roots are stuck in a deadlock, being evenly matched. The plant is killed in one move by Hei Lou Lan, who entered the ground. Wu Guang thanks Chen Cheng for saving his life. Chen Cheng says he was only assisting, and that the one who saved Wu Guang is his master. Hei Lou Lan flies up from the ground. The black tiger returns to her and turns into a tattoo on her skin, named as the totem killer move Dark Capital Strength Tiger.

After Hei Lou Lan strikes Liu Luo and Liu Chang, eight strength path phantoms appear around her, and the dark capital strength tiger totem is also summoned. Liu Chang and Liu Luo are beaten to a pulp.
